title: Separate wall-clock speedup from total work and queue wait
narrative: Nubble starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`. Nubble is asked whether parallel agents sped things up. Wall time dropped, but total work grew and queue waits hid under a vanity speedup. He needs metrics that separate critical path, total work, and elapsed time — and that refuse misleading efficiency claims without a serial baseline and worker-count note.
validation: Harness `user_story` drives product verb(s) with environment `pass_through`/`mock`; hard expects on declared observation keys.
